kind: read-only Apple ARM64 preflight measurement synthesis

spu-mfc.timingScope: Only noinline native mask helper including actual ARM64 get_tsc hardware instruction (mrs cntvct_el0), compiler barriers and call/loop overhead; no real DMA or full do_mfc timing.
spu-mfc.clockDistinction: Functional equivalence and clock-read counts use a deterministic clock adapter. The separately compiled plain timing extracts the production get_tsc and uses the real ARM64 counter.
spu-mfc.finding: All four Apple median mask timings regressed; removed clock-read counts do not establish an Apple elapsed-time improvement.

spu-timer.timingScope: Production locked sweep with ordinary std::vectors and a host mutex, including input-vector reassignment and due-vector creation/destruction in the timed loop. Guest time/scheduling and atomic publication are adapted, not a complete scheduler.
spu-timer.counterQualification: candidateShiftedSlots=0 counts erase-induced shifts only; it does not mean the stable compaction performs zero element moves.
spu-timer.finding: Expired batches are faster in this host benchmark, but no-expiry medians regress for 6, 32 and 1024 entries and exhibit substantial spread.

descriptor-bind.timingScope: Host iOS-code-path wrapper with noinline mock vkCmdBindDescriptorSets that increments a counter and checksum. Capture/model recording disabled during timing. No Vulkan device, MoltenVK, GPU or real driver cost.
descriptor-bind.finding: Alternating bind points improve and redundant emissions drop, while pure graphics hits and changing handles cost more. Correctness errors fall from 1141 to zero; total call counts must not be treated as a universal reduction because previously incorrect omissions are repaired.
descriptor-bind.memoryQualification: Mock iOS command-buffer size increases 288 to 336 bytes (+48), with unchanged allocation counts in program fixtures. This is not a full Core RSS measurement.
descriptor-bind.desktopQualification: Unchanged desktop native path intentionally retains baseline errors (1141) and expected returncode 86; only candidate-ios fixes them. Wrapper passed=true reflects this explicit control.

texture-hash-reuse.timingScope: Production XXH3 cached seeded secret and host SIMD; 8 validation sections per round. Ordinary embedded correctness-harness benchmark, observer disabled, worker still exists with no previous-frame speculation, epoch notification omitted to avoid wake-up jitter. This is not the separate isolated Linux measurement-only benchmark.
texture-hash-reuse.finding: Eligible repeated ranges reduce 96 hashes to 12 and 6291456 bytes to 786432 bytes. Distinct ranges remain 32/32 hashes; no universal improvement is established. Distinct 32768 and 3686400-byte and bypass 3686400-byte medians regress, with overlapping ranges.
scopeNotes: 32 KiB is an ineligible-size control: no hash reuse expected.
Automatic prehash remains GOW3 only; useful hit frequency in games is not measured.
Existing prehash-hit counters include synchronous producers and must not be attributed entirely to the worker.
Stress accepted-match counts are correctness-path observations, not hit-rate/throughput measurements; baseline has one publisher, candidate has two.
No guest GPU writes or hybrid hash implementation executed.

neoswap-discard.timingScope: Metadata-only collect_discarded loop, 16 queued jobs. No disk I/O, compression or full-worker mutex/queue processing in timed region. Empty pending-discard flag permits early return; live entries skip queue search before retired entry checks.
neoswap-discard.functionalScope: Separate 11 complete production Store cases really execute POSIX file, VM, fault and concurrency paths on Darwin, linking Apple Compression and zlib. Not a NAND latency benchmark.
neoswap-discard.finding: No median regressions in these 10 Apple metadata cases (empty/no-retirement unchanged). Large early-return savings are local call savings, not whole-emulator or restore performance.
limitations: Original report retains medians only; per-series ranges cannot be reconstructed.
4096 live + 1 retained retired entry exceeds the real 4096 entry limit; retained only as synthetic boundary, do not promote as a realizable workload.
These are macOS ARM64 host microbenchmarks, not iPhone 16 Pro Max or full-game measurements. No FPS/frame-time improvement is established.
MFC and timer results were executed in run 40900528171 and authenticated/reused in this preflight; descriptor, hash and NeoSwap are newly executed here.
Sanitizer timings are not used. Seven series are summarized by median; series ranges are included when the original report recorded them. No confidence intervals or independent-session repeats exist.
Positive durationChangePercent means a slower candidate. All observed regressing median cases are retained, without claiming statistical significance.
